item.title: Transforming the Operations System with an Event Bus
item.description: 1. An Operations Service System That Has Piled Up Beyond Repair Developing a corresponding operations service for a clear operations need, so that operations and business users can use it, is entirely reasonable. But if you are satisfied with only that, the following situation easily appears: Users constantly look for the entry point of each system, jumping back and forth between systems, busy hunting for buttons and copying parameters.
